objective: Mine openai/codex, NousResearch/hermes-agent and openclaw/openclaw for Windows-native failure mechanisms and reflect every non-duplicate one into the fuck-powershell corpus, one PABCD work-phase per repository, then ship and verify live.

workPhases.title: Docs-first roadmap: clone, freeze inventories, write the decade docs

tasks.title: Shallow-clone the three upstream repos read-only
Freeze commit and open-issue inventories per repo
Write 000 plan plus a diff-level decade doc per repo

workPhases.title: openai/codex: disposition the inventory, write non-duplicate cases

tasks.title: Dispatch a read-only grok-4.6 explorer over the codex inventory
Re-read every anchor first-hand and write accepted cases
A-gate reviewer verifies claims against primary sources

workPhases.title: NousResearch/hermes-agent: disposition the inventory, write non-duplicate cases

tasks.title: Dispatch a read-only grok-4.6 explorer over the hermes inventory
Re-read every anchor first-hand and write accepted cases
A-gate reviewer verifies claims against primary sources

workPhases.title: openclaw/openclaw: disposition the inventory, write non-duplicate cases

tasks.title: Dispatch a read-only grok-4.6 explorer over the openclaw inventory
Re-read every anchor first-hand and write accepted cases
A-gate reviewer verifies claims against primary sources

workPhases.title: Ship: issues, counts, push, live verification

tasks.title: Create, cross-link and close an issue per new case
Sync README and ontology counts to the real totals
Push, confirm the Pages deploy, fetch a new case page

criteria.scenario: wp0 closes with a 000 plan and one diff-level decade doc per repo, naming the surfaces and candidate mechanisms each is expected to yield
criteria.expectedEvidence: ls plus head of devlog/260828_upstream3/*.md showing non-outline content

criteria.scenario: Each repo has a frozen commit inventory and a frozen open-issue inventory, both reproducible from the recorded commands
criteria.expectedEvidence: wc -l of devlog/260828_upstream3/inv/* plus the grep and gh search commands in the plan

criteria.scenario: Every row in the codex inventories appears in the codex disposition table
Every row in the hermes-agent inventories appears in its disposition table
Every row in the openclaw inventories appears in its disposition table
After every case-writing work-phase the full chain succeeds and the five prior mining coverage checks stay at 100 percent
criteria.expectedEvidence: fresh command output with exit codes captured in a check receipt

criteria.scenario: New cases have issues that are cross-linked and closed, counts agree with the file count, origin main carries the work, and the live site serves a new case page
criteria.expectedEvidence: issue URLs, README grep, push output, deploy conclusion, and an HTTP 200 from the live case URL
